CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to contents was stated.

COD.rationale: Content identifier (red) and its presentation/organization (origin/current) are both explicitly stated for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: Report lists provenance and candidate/current states but gives no explicit attention/allocation condition linked to content presentation.

C.rationale: The text names specific content referents with attributes (red/blue) and explicit coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Content values are listed separately from provenance/status fields (origin/current), distinguishing identification from presentation/status.

O.rationale: The report specifies how the content is represented/accessed (current vs candidate) and provides provenance/origin metadata for the same referent.
